meta.name: The Tax Free Tour
meta.description: The Tax Free Tourtravels the globe to expose the workings of offshore tax havens and the elite banking systems of the world’s billionaires which operate in extreme secrecy. Using examples from multi-national corporations such as Apple Computer and Starbucks, the film traces sizeable capital streams that travel the world literally in milliseconds–all to avoid local laws and paying tax. Such routes go by resounding names like ‘Cayman Special’, ‘Double Irish’, and ‘Dutch Sandwich’.The Tax Free Touris a sobering look at how the world’s rich live in an entirely different world than the rest of us…
